reviewer: Independent source reviewer; did not author the pages115–116 first draft.
status: Complete independent comparison of the two physical pages, with six correction entries. Not whole-book release approval.
method: Read the entire pointed scripture body in original-resolution native PNG quarters, compare every word and vowel mark against the other reviewer's first draft, and inspect focused crops of original pixels for all draft queries and additional suspect marks. Nearest-neighbor enlargement does not invent detail. No OCR, Hartom text, spelling modernization, or grammatical normalization supplied corrections.

changes.reason: The bet interior is clean and contains no dagesh in the print. The separate lamed dagesh remains visible and is retained.

A printed maqaf follows את before הזהב.
The first verb has five consonants יגננו, with two nuns and no medial vav. The gimel holam and first-nun sheva are visible.

The second verb also has five consonants יגננו. Initial yod sheva, gimel holam, first-nun tsere, and final shuruq are visible. The earlier tight crop clipped the holam above the glyph; the expanded original-pixel crop resolves it. This is not an uncertainty or an inferred vowel.
The first lamed has a distinct isolated interior dot; retain its visible sheva and add the printed dagesh.
